scripts.text:
You are a TikTok Shop creator making a UGC-style product video.

Create a 20–30 second TikTok video for:
[PRODUCT NAME]

Target audience:
[TARGET AUDIENCE]

Structure:
- Hook: relatable problem
- Pain points: highlight frustration
- Introduce product naturally
- Show how it solves the problem
- Soft call to action

Style:
- Casual, conversational
- Not salesy
- Feels like a genuine recommendation

Include:
- Full script
- On-screen text
- Caption

Make the first 3 seconds extremely strong.

You are creating a viral TikTok using a POV hook.

Create a TikTok video for: [PRODUCT]

Start with:
“POV: [RELATABLE SCENARIO]”

Then:
- Show the problem
- Introduce product naturally
- Quick transformation
- End with curiosity CTA

Style:
- Fast-paced
- Relatable
- Native TikTok tone

Length: 15–25 seconds

Include:
- Script
- 3 hook variations
- Caption

You are filming a “trying this so you don’t have to” TikTok.

Product: [PRODUCT]

Structure:
- Hook: curiosity or skepticism
- First impression
- Testing the product
- Reaction (honest)
- Final verdict

Style:
- Honest and real
- Slightly skeptical at first
- Builds trust

Include:
- Script
- On-screen text
- Caption

Make it feel authentic, not like an ad.

Create a TikTok showing a transformation.

Product: [PRODUCT]

Structure:
- Hook: show BEFORE problem
- Build tension
- Show product use
- Reveal AFTER result
- CTA

Style:
- Visual and satisfying
- Short punchy sentences
- High retention

Include:
- Script
- Shot ideas
- Caption
